clips.title: The story
paras: This quest tasks an Alliance warlock with tracking down the scattered, ruined halves of a singular grimoire known as the Tome of the Cabal. Recovering the missing pages from distant lands is essential for deciphering the dark rites necessary to bind a felhunter.

Only a single copy of the Tome of the Cabal was ever scribed, and its violent history ensured it did not stay intact. Torn apart and vandalized, its remnants were scattered to entirely different corners of the world. One portion, a tattered manuscript ripped straight from the binding, somehow found its way across the sea into the rugged canyons of Kalimdor, falling into the hands of the centaur clans. The remaining section was intended for transport by sea from the shores of Lordaeron down to Khaz Modan, but the vessel foundered before reaching its port.

Reassembling the grimoire demands surviving two treacherous perils. The sea-lost pages washed ashore off the Hillsbrad coast west of Southshore, where scavenged debris and waterlogged relics fell into the grasp of shoreline murlocs near Azurelode Mine. Meanwhile, recovering the arid half requires infiltrating Splithoof Hold in Thousand Needles, delving deep into centaur caverns to reclaim the manuscript from an ancient chest. Only by uniting these disparate halves can Krom Stoutarm inspect the lost text before it returns to Strahad Farsan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It was lost, but there's some idea as to where it might be found.

There was only one copy ever made and it was vandalized at some point, a large portion of it ripped from the binding. Rumor has it that it somehow passed into the hands of the centaur of Thousand Needles.
The rest was lost off the coast west of Southshore, where it was to be transported to Menethil Harbor by boat. It never arrived.
In exchange for this knowledge, all I ask is that if you find it, bring it to me to see.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did the rumors prove true, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Fantastic! Now I may join the ranks of the few that have spied its contents.
I can't wait to further peruse this text. This is a great day, friend! If you will just allow me to glance at it before you leave. I'm sure that Strahad will be willing to send me a copy.
